records.title: Bitquery — Binance hack, issuer freezes, DEX routes and chain-level balances
records.note: Bitquery reports Circle froze 823M USDC in the main Ethereum receiver at 21:04 UTC on 2026-10-29, three minutes after Tether's first freeze and before any of that USDC moved. It reports Tether froze 1.76B USDT, about 71% of stolen USDT, while approximately 729M USDT moved before freezes and was converted through UniswapX, 1inch Fusion, Uniswap pools and SunSwap; some USDT was supplied to Aave as collateral for ETH loans. Smaller issuer freezes involving WLFI, USD1, Tether Gold, Paxos, Ripple and First Digital totaled about USD 132M, but Bitquery does not isolate Ripple's amount. At its 2026-10-30 06:43 UTC cutoff, 233.5M XRP remained at the XRP receiver with no outgoing payment observed and no known exchange, mixer or bridge destination. Bitquery says the XRP and Solana receivers share no address with other chain clusters; linkage is based on timing, transaction construction and Binance's aggregate damage. It reports all 17 drained hot wallets carry Binance PoR labels in its address data. Every drain carried a valid Binance signature; on 16 of 17 wallets Binance's system signed ordinary transfers. XRP and TRON payments used unusual settings and higher fees. This does not prove private-key exfiltration or identify who requested signatures.

records.title: Reuters — Analysts react as Binance freezes assets after $6.3B security breach
records.note: Reuters reports BTC fell about 3%, ETH more than 3%, and Coinbase shares fell 4.8% in extended US trading after the incident. A GSR systematic OTC executive said Binance BTC spot spreads were about five times normal and ETH spreads about 2.5 times normal earlier that morning, later narrowing slightly. HashKey warned paused deposits/withdrawals could impair market-maker cross-venue capital movement and trigger margin shortages or forced liquidations; another analyst said DEXs could benefit if activity migrates on-chain. These are market observations and analyst assessments, not evidence of Coinbase customer migration, XRP-specific spread widening or realized DEX inflows.
